method.name: get_status_string
method.description: Returns the skin-tokens status enum as a string. Until upstream ships a status-to-string helper, the value is the enum ordinal rendered decimal.

method.name: rig_file
method.description: Rig an unrigged GLB at [param mesh_path] using the skin-tokens bundle at [param bundle_path], writing the rigged GLB to [param output_path]. Optional [param opts] keys: [code skip-lint]device[/code] (0 auto, 1 CPU, 2 Vulkan), [code skip-lint]seed[/code], [code skip-lint]top_k[/code], [code skip-lint]top_p[/code], [code skip-lint]temperature[/code], [code skip-lint]repetition_penalty[/code], [code skip-lint]beams[/code], [code skip-lint]max_tokens[/code], [code skip-lint]geometric_only[/code]. Returns the [code skip-lint]st_status[/code] enum: 0 on success; any other value is a failure whose reason is pushed through [method @GlobalScope.printerr] before this method returns.
